headline: Tesla renames 'Full Self-Driving' to 'Assisted Driving' in Europe
summary: Tesla has renamed its 'Full Self-Driving' feature to 'Assisted Driving' in Europe after facing criticism that the original name misled drivers. The change prompted Germany's transport minister to advocate for Europe-wide adoption of the driver assistance software.
